subject: Upcoming Family Gathering Details
body: Dear Family Members, I hope this message finds you well. I am writing to inform you that the upcoming family gathering will be held at the Smith residence on Saturday, May 15th, starting at 2:00 PM. Please make sure to RSVP by May 10th so we can finalize the arrangements. We will have a barbecue, games for the kids, and a potluck-style dinner. Looking forward to seeing everyone and catching up! If you have any questions, feel free to reach out. Best regards, [Your Name]
